test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some plants are spices.

No spice is a lentil.

Conclusions:

(i) Some lentils are plants.

(ii) Some spices are plants.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/336053d664f08bd2f9ca0d440d7ef9f19cac84a201004dd263de6a70f96c4d92.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) Some lentils are plants → Does not follow (As some plants are spices and no spice is a lentil. So it is possible but not definite)

(ii) Some spices are plants → Follow (As some plants are spices. As some part of plants is common with spices, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (ii) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
